name: Onna no Otoko Kenkyuusho
source:
Ayae Matsudo (female, scientist) awoke with a jolt.
She'd dreamed that the world was nothing but men.
"This will the downfall of humankind!" she gasped.

Immediately she set to work on a boy-girl hybridization.

This beautiful genius, this inventive doctor Ayae,
would save the world from its own gender death.
She would create feminized men.

[From DLsite English]
translation:
松户绫绘（女性，科学家）猛地从梦中惊醒。
她刚刚做了一个噩梦，梦见整个世界只剩下了男人。
“这会导致全人类灭亡的！”她倒吸了一口凉气。

刻不容缓，她当即着手投入“男女混合改造”的研究之中。

这位美貌非凡的天才、富有创造力的发明家绫绘博士，
立志要将整个世界从性别失衡的灭顶之灾中拯救出来——
她要亲手创造出雌化的男人们。

[摘自DLsite英文版]
